tools.description: Start here. Inspect the open world, active map/layer, maps, revision, clients and transaction. No arguments or open world required. Use returned worldSessionId in every subsequent context. Workflow: get_session → inspect catalogs/maps → begin_edit → paint/place/preview/validate → finish_edit → wait for human Onayla or Vazgeç. Poll transactionId to learn the final approval/cancellation outcome. Never approve or save yourself.
tools.name: get_session
tools.title: Get Session

tools.description: Inspect one map and its layers without changing the user’s selected map. Obtain stable mapId from get_session and layerId/kind/visibility/locks here before painting. context is optional. Dimensions are cells; tileWidth/tileHeight are native pixels.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: get_map_info
tools.title: Get Map Info

tools.description: Read a bounded rectangle from explicit mapId and layerIds. context is optional. Coordinates are zero-based map cells, x right/y down; region is half-open {x,y,width,height}. Cells are row-major local legend refs (0 empty), not document palette indices; collision layers use raw 0/1/2. Maximum 4096 cells/layer, 16384 total, 8 layers, 256 entities.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: read_region
tools.title: Read Region

tools.description: Discover tileset IDs, names, native tile sizes and sheet grid dimensions before choosing art. Use includeDetails:false for initial discovery without hashing source pixels; fingerprint/tagCounts are omitted. Default includeDetails:true computes those details and can be expensive for large cold atlases. context is optional. Page limit 1–128 (default 64); reuse nextCursor unchanged with the same filters/world revision. Then call get_tile_catalog with images to inspect the actual art.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: list_tilesets
tools.title: List Tilesets

tools.description: Sheet mode is a continuous atlas crop with compact sheet grid/source metadata and no per-tile placements. sheetRegion determines the row-major metadata page; offset/nextOffset are relative to that region. Sheet mode cannot combine tileIds. Inspect real tile art and stable numeric tile IDs before choosing tiles. context is optional. image:"tiles" returns a labelled contact sheet (≤64 tiles); image:"sheet" returns a labelled sheetRegion in tileset grid cells; image:"none" returns metadata only (≤128). Choose either tileIds or offset/limit. scale is 1,2,4. One ID gives a cropped tile. sourceRect is native source pixels; labels occupy separate gutters. PNG ≤2048 px/side and 4 MiB. Select a smaller page/region when too large. Tile meanings are not inferred from IDs.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

Search normalized names, categories, library tags and current semantic labels with query; paginate ≤32 records (default 16); previewStampId adds one real PNG. Use place_stamp for flat objects, or prepare_smart_source only for suitable smart art.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: list_stamps
tools.title: List Stamps

tools.description: Begin one tentative draft. requestLabel describes the user’s request, mapIds names 1–8 explicit targets; context, expectedRevision (CAS) and idempotencyKey are optional. Later writes may omit context: they use this draft. unlockLayerIds unlocks/shows those layers inside the draft so you can paint them. Returns resumeToken: keep it secret; after a disconnect, restart or finish_edit call resume_edit({transactionId,resumeToken}) to continue the same draft. One world writer, ≤4096 mutation calls, 1048576 planned cell writes per draft. Inactivity lease 30 minutes, extended by every call; on lease end or disconnect the draft is sealed for human review, never rolled back. finish_edit requests review; only the user approves. Optional collaboration:{mode:'regions',claims?} creates one shared draft. Claims are explicit existing map/layer rectangles. Omit claims for coordinator metadata preparation, then self join_edit once to assign regions before peers join. Prepare shared metadata before any spatial write or peer join. Returns memberId/memberRevision for explicit member-scoped CAS.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: begin_edit
tools.title: Begin Edit

tools.description: Finish the drawing and request human review; returns awaitingApproval immediately. context is optional. Optional summary describes changes. Writes are sealed and locks remain; resume_edit with your resumeToken reopens the draft if you must amend it. Only the user can Onayla (one undo row) or Vazgeç (rollback). Poll get_session(transactionId); never attempt to approve/save via a tool. In a collaborative draft this marks only your member ready; peers remain writable. Coordinator finish closes new joins. The group awaits human approval once all members are ready/stopped/cancelled.

WriteContext.description: Optional; omit it entirely in an ordinary edit. Omitted fields use the open world and your own active edit, calls apply in arrival order without revision checks and are not replay-cached. Supply idempotencyKey to make a retry safe (same payload/key replays), expectedRevision for strict whole-world CAS. Collaborative drafts need expectedRevision or expectedMemberRevision (never both).

tools.name: finish_edit
tools.title: Finish Edit

tools.description: Discard your owned tentative edit and restore its original maps, palettes and project metadata. context is optional; cancellation accepts a stale expectedRevision. After a disconnect pass resumeToken (with context.transactionId) to discard your orphaned or submitted draft. Provisional maps disappear. Independently written semantic tags survive. User may also discard locally. In a collaborative draft with peers this rolls back only your bounded spatial contribution and releases your claims; peer contributions/shared setup remain pending. Before any peer joined, cancellation can discard the whole proposal. No agent can discard peers or approve the group.

Each page scans at most 4096 records and returns ≤256 issues (default 128). Follow every revision-bound nextCursor with unchanged arguments/world until nextCursor:null; valid:null means incomplete, and only final valid:true proves integrity. tools.title: Get Editor State

tools.description: Set explicit UI controls without changing document data or requiring begin_edit. Available during running/stopped/awaitingApproval proposals. Activate map/layer, select existing tile/stamp/entity, set marquee, tile/pixel tools, brush/rectangle options, grid/major grid/collision/minimap/rulers/canvas mode, camera view/zoom/center (map cells), atlas filter/view/zoom and pixel colors/mirrors. All target IDs and bounds validate before applying settings; no painting, PNG write, undo or proposal approval. Camera animation may settle after reply. Optional context rejects replaced worlds.

Point.description: Zero-based map-cell coordinate, x right and y down unless the tool explicitly states world pixels.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

Rect.description: Half-open rectangle: x <= cellX < x+width, y <= cellY < y+height; map cells unless explicitly a tileset sheet region.

Tile.description: Stable tilesetId/tileId from catalog, with optional compact D4 flags H=1,V=2,D=4; not a palette integer.

tools.name: configure_editor
tools.title: Configure Editor

tools.description: Show/hide/reveal and move/reorder panels, split groups, expand/collapse/hide dock zones, resize zones (UI clamps normal size limits), or reset layout. Persists through the normal dock settings writer. Independent of document review; cannot approve edits. group/index are zero-based, split creates a group at start/end.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: configure_layout
tools.title: Configure Layout

tools.description: Persist locale and shortcut overrides with the application's serialized settings writer, rejecting unknown commands, malformed chords and shortcut conflicts. null removes an override and restores defaults; [] unbinds. Read get_editor_state for available locales and defaults. Rejects an open settings preview to preserve the user's draft. Never changes MCP server/token or writes document/PNG data. Works without a world and during proposal review.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: configure_application
tools.title: Configure Application

tools.description: Discover current command IDs, translated labels, categories, enabled/check state, shortcuts and remoteExecutable status/reason. Query matches ID/title/category. Only the explicit UI allowlist can execute via run_editor_command; document mutations use transaction tools and AI approval remains human-only. Paginated, at most 128 commands per page.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: list_editor_commands
tools.title: List Editor Commands

tools.description: Invoke one enabled UI command from list_editor_commands where remoteExecutable=true. Explicit allowlist covers view navigation/toggles, tool switches, settings dialogs, palette, pixel colors and selection-only commands. Does not execute arbitrary command IDs, file operations, document mutations or AI approval/discard. This action is not replay-cached: toggles execute once per call; use configure_editor/configure_layout for retry-safe absolute setters.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: run_editor_command
tools.title: Run Editor Command

tools.description: Rename an existing transaction target map and/or move it in world view. world coordinates are signed whole pixels (not map cells). IDs, files and map cells remain stable. Requires begin_edit; joins the same pending approval, cancellation, replay and world undo action as painting.

WriteContext.description: Optional; omit it entirely in an ordinary edit. Omitted fields use the open world and your own active edit, calls apply in arrival order without revision checks and are not replay-cached. Supply idempotencyKey to make a retry safe (same payload/key replays), expectedRevision for strict whole-world CAS. Collaborative drafts need expectedRevision or expectedMemberRevision (never both).

tools.name: edit_map
tools.title: Edit Map Metadata

tools.description: Update a saved stamp's name/category/tags/favorite, duplicate it with a unique stable ID, or remove it from the library. Already placed map cells remain ordinary tiles. Metadata and library membership are staged in the current edit; cancellation restores originals and approval joins one reversible world action. Does not touch source PNGs or regenerate artwork. Requires begin_edit and replay key.

WriteContext.description: Optional; omit it entirely in an ordinary edit. Omitted fields use the open world and your own active edit, calls apply in arrival order without revision checks and are not replay-cached. Supply idempotencyKey to make a retry safe (same payload/key replays), expectedRevision for strict whole-world CAS. Collaborative drafts need expectedRevision or expectedMemberRevision (never both).

tools.name: edit_stamp
tools.title: Edit Stamp Library

tools.description: Read this world's new-map tile size, dimensions, layer template, canvas background and Unity defaults. Inspect before configure_world. No changes.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.

tools.name: get_world_settings
tools.title: Get World Settings

tools.description: Patch world defaults for future maps: tile size, new-map dimensions, layer template and canvas background (#rrggbb or null). Existing maps/tiles/pixels keep their dimensions. Requires begin_edit; pending review, discard and approved undo cover settings alongside document edits. No path, auto-export or server/token changes. UI view/preferences use configure_editor/configure_application.

WriteContext.description: Optional; omit it entirely in an ordinary edit. Omitted fields use the open world and your own active edit, calls apply in arrival order without revision checks and are not replay-cached. Supply idempotencyKey to make a retry safe (same payload/key replays), expectedRevision for strict whole-world CAS. Collaborative drafts need expectedRevision or expectedMemberRevision (never both).

tools.name: configure_world
tools.title: Configure World

tools.description: Join an existing shared draft as your authenticated client, claiming 1–16 immutable rectangles on explicit existing map/layer IDs. Overlap on the same map/layer fails REGION_CONFLICT before mutation; disjoint regions can share one layer. Founder begin_edit may omit claims for prep-only setup, then call join_edit once to assign its own claims before peers join. Peers join only while coordinator is open and has claims. Global metadata is frozen after the first spatial write or first peer join. Returns memberId/memberRevision; subsequent writes may use expectedMemberRevision instead of strict global expectedRevision (exactly one). finish_edit submits only your member; cancel_edit rolls back only your spatial contribution, preserving peers/shared setup. Human approval/discard applies to the combined draft.

ReadContext.description: Optional. Omit to use the open world; pass worldSessionId from get_session only to reject a replaced world.
